proof_scope: real-world end-to-end behavior: the LIVE nightly runs, browser-captures the real SAM.gov site, sweeps the real Greenhouse/Ashby/DARPA boards, writes real memory, keeps only recent (<=2wk) jobs, tailors a custom resume per top job (human-submit-gated), captures live ATS form schemas, and the enforcement gates + fabrication guard hold

claims.proves: a live nightly produces a real recent-only shortlist from real live boards + a real SAM website capture, tailors multiple custom resumes bound to approved claims (all submit-gated), captures live ATS application-form schemas read-only, writes recallable memory, refuses to silently skip a dead-API source, enforces the 2-week recency window, and carries no fabricated 'God of War' claim
